def min_checkpoints_and_moves(T, test_cases):
    results = []
    for case in test_cases:
        N, c, points = case
        # Calculate the differences between points
        diff_x = [points[i][0] - points[i][1] for i in range(N)]
        diff_y = [points[i][1] - points[i][0] for i in range(N)]
        
        # Find the unique differences
        unique_diff_x = sorted(set(diff_x))
        unique_diff_y = sorted(set(diff_y))
        
        # Determine the number of checkpoints
        checkpoints_x = len(unique_diff_x)
        checkpoints_y = len(unique_diff_y)
        min_checkpoints = max(checkpoints_x, checkpoints_y)
        
        # Calculate the number of moves
        moves = 0
        for i in range(N):
            moves += min(abs(diff_x[i] - unique_diff_x[checkpoints_x - 1]), 
                         abs(diff_y[i] - unique_diff_y[checkpoints_y - 1]))
        
        results.append((min_checkpoints, moves))
    return results
